record.paper_title: Lower Bounds for Unrestricted Boolean Circuits: Open Problems
record.original_question: What is the Boolean-circuit size of SUM_n, the multi-output Boolean function that returns the binary encoding of the sum of the n input bits?

evidence.quote: Note that the multi-output function SUMn ∈ Bn,⌈log2(n+1)⌉ that outputs the binary encoding of the sum of n input bits is not easier than any symmetric function f ∈ Bn:
What is the circuit size of SUMn?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For each positive integer $n$, let $\mathrm{SUM}_n : \{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}^{\lceil \log_2(n+1)\rceil}$ denote the multi-output Boolean function that maps an input $(x_1,\ldots,x_n) \in \{0,1\}^n$ to the binary encoding of the integer $x_1 + x_2 + \cdots + x_n$. The Boolean circuit size of a multi-output function $f$ is the minimum number of gates in a circuit over the full binary basis $B_2$ (the set of all two-input Boolean functions) that computes $f$, where each gate has fan-in at most $2$ and fan-out is unbounded.

Determine the Boolean circuit size of $\mathrm{SUM}_n$ as a function of $n$. In particular, determine the asymptotic constant $c$ such that the circuit size of $\mathrm{SUM}_n$ equals $cn + o(n)$, or otherwise establish matching upper and lower bounds.
artifact.status_search_result: The exact Boolean circuit size of SUM_n remains open. Known upper bounds for symmetric functions (which include SUM_n) are of the form 4.5n + o(n), while only linear lower bounds of the form (3 + 1/86)n - o(n) over the full binary basis are known, and these apply to specific functions rather than tight bounds for SUM_n. No matching upper and lower bounds have been established.

status_evidence.title: Circuit Complexity: New Techniques and Their Limitations (Golovnev)
status_evidence.snippet: Symmetric functions can be computed by circuits of size 4.5n + o(n); known linear lower bounds for explicit functions over the full binary basis are around (3 + 1/86)n - o(n).
status_evidence.claim: There is a gap between the best known upper and lower bounds for the circuit size of symmetric functions including SUM_n.

status_evidence.title: New upper bounds on the Boolean circuit complexity of symmetric functions
status_evidence.snippet: Improved upper bounds on the circuit size of symmetric Boolean functions, including the binary-sum function.
status_evidence.claim: Research continues to improve upper bounds, indicating the exact circuit size of SUM_n is not known.
